name: Rákóczibánya (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Rákóczibánya: a yellow shield with two black eagles, with a crossed-hammers crest and black and yellow mantling, above a scroll inscribed Rákóczibánya.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Rákóczibánya arms with crest, mantling and scroll
